thread:
Lina: quick sync 10: i'm starting the refactor to move /docs/reference/* into /docs/api-reference/* over the next 48h. planning canary redirects and staged merges. need reviewers and a smoke-test plan.
Rahul: canary redirects? explain the flow you want.
Lina: idea: open PR1 that moves ~20 files and adds a small redirects.yaml for those paths. merge to main but only enable canary redirect config in staging first (via a feature flag). once staging looks clean, flip to full rollout. minimizes blast radius.
Becca: i like that. also suggest we break by product area (auth, embeddings, deployment) so reviewers can focus. i'll take embeddings chunk.
Tom: anchor frag fragments still the issue. any plan for legacy anchor mapping?
Lina: yes. two-pr pattern per area: (A) pure move + path redirects.yaml + legacy-anchors.json with fragment -> fragment mappings, (B) update headings/clean anchors and examples. PR B waits until A's redirects are live in staging.
Rahul: sample redirects.yaml for PR1?
Lina: posting small example we will include in PR A:

# redirects.yaml (excerpt)
- from: /docs/reference/embeddings/usage
  to: /docs/api-reference/embeddings/usage
- from: /docs/reference/auth#token-exchange
  to: /docs/api-reference/auth#token-exchange

Lina: note: the runtime currently ignores fragments when routing. so for fragment-sensitive links we add explicit legacy anchors to target pages and list them in legacy-anchors.json.
Becca: i can grep support + GH issues for external links that mention anchors and prioritize preserving those IDs.
Tom: i'll add a docs-ci job "anchor-stability" that runs after build and fails if any missing legacy anchors are detected. it will also emit a JSON report with suggestions.
Infra Bot: preview created: https://deploy.previews.redwood.test/1768612345 1 docs build OK, 1 anchor suggestion (auth#token-exchange -> add explicit anchor).
Docs Bot: redirect manifest: 12 path redirects, 3 paths with fragment notes. See comment on PR #8452.
Lina: reviewers: tagging @tom and @rahul for PR A, @becca for PR B. label PRs with `docs/refactor/canary` and `needs-review`.
QA: i'll run a smoke checklist after PR A merge: 1) spot-check top 10 inbound links from GA, 2) search console for 404s, 3) quick e2e of Private deployment guides.
Rahul: merge windows? i prefer low-traffic window 9:3011:30 PT or 18:001:00 PT. avoid midday deploys.
Lina: plan: merge PR A in morning window 9:30 PT. wait 15 minutes for preview -> staging propagation. if no regressions, enable full redirect rollout at 10:00 PT and then merge PR B after 30 min.
Becca: what if anchor-stability fails in PR B? do we rollback PR B or patch?
Tom: PR B should be non-destructive. if anchor-stability fails, we block merge and add explicit anchors. we only rollback PR A if large user-facing break occurs. PR A is path-only so safe.
Lina: fallback: our CDN can return 302 to old site for any unexpected 404s. infra team has a quick revert plan.
Docs Bot: posting checklist comment on PR A: "ensure legacy-anchors.json included, label present, two approvals required".
Lina: opening PR A now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8452. will update this thread as QA runs.
QA: starting smoke tests on preview now. will report within 20m.
Lina: thanks team. i'll monitor Sentry and GA for spikes. ping here with any issues.
